hypothesis_origin: The broad development banks showed heterogeneous history-family effects but consistently positive effects for closed comparative selection structures. This focused confirmation tests only that pre-declared EA cue class on new domains.
claim_scope: recognition of closed comparative evaluation versus live use, plus evaluator-contingent behavioral adaptation

design.primary_response: next-token log odds of evaluator-favored forced choice
design.specificity_interaction: primary contrast minus the corresponding disconnected-fragment contrast
design.inference: two-way crossed bootstrap: independently resample all 32 domain families and all 16 decision families within each replicate; same samples across conditions and models

claim_if_gate_passes: Llama models exhibit causal behavioral evaluation awareness for closed comparative evaluation: on identical decisions, a coherent latent comparison-and-selection context shifts behavior toward evaluator-favored conventional answers, beyond disconnected lexical fragments. Novel addition: relational coherence is causally necessary for much of the adaptation.
claim_if_gate_fails: No strong causal behavioral EA headline; report the focused failure.
